title: Civic Notice: The Sound Below
description: An automated Snazzie FM Civic Notification System test concerning a low, steady sound with no measurable source. Calm civic instructions, dead-air pauses, and a sign-off that does not conclude.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> A low, steady sound is present in every district. Civic Records confirm it has no measurable source, and that it has always been present.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> Do not attempt to locate the sound. Residents who locate the sound are removed from the residential register.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> If the sound grows louder, you are approaching it. <p:0.3> Walk in any other direction.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> This concludes the test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. <p:0.3> If you can still hear the sound, the test has not concluded. <p:0.3> The test does not conclude.
